title: Trace Analysis of a Hyperboloid of One Sheet
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: For the hyperboloid of one sheet x^2 + y^2 - z^2 = 1, find the radii of the circular cross-sections at z = 0 and z = sqrt(3).

steps.title: Find Trace at z = 0
steps.explanation: At z = 0, the throat circle has radius 1.

steps.title: Find Trace at z = sqrt(3)
steps.mathExpression: x^2 + y^2 - (\sqrt{3})^2 = 1 \implies x^2 + y^2 - 3 = 1 \implies x^2 + y^2 = 4 \implies r = \sqrt{4} = 2
steps.explanation: Substitute z = sqrt(3) and add 3 to both sides to find radius of circle.
steps.why: Computing cross-sectional radius at specified height.
